quest.title: Lost in a Foreign Land: Seeking
quest.description: You run into a Fatui mage named Katarina who is wandering alone in The Chasm. What is she doing here? Ask her what's going on.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... There's no sign of anyone. What are we supposed to tell Katya?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Paimon guesses there's not much we can do. Let's head back.

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: Ah, you came! Sit and make yourself at home.

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: I'm sorry that I sent you away in a hurry last time. I didn't even tell you what I wanted you to help me with.

choices.text: It's fine. You can say it now.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Relax, I won't make you do anything evil.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Well, I have been separated from my Kolya — Nikolay, a member of my team.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Could you help me look for him?

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: If he's still alive, bring him back to me. If he's dead... please let me know.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: I'm sorry to lay this on you... But please consider my request.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, this is what you want us to do? Paimon thought you were up to something bad like, say, asking us to sabotage the Millelith's work...

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: The Millelith... why? It does no good to make them our enemy.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do you mean?

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: That's my line!

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Hang on, I got it... Did our people on the surface get into an altercation with the people of Liyue? That would certainly explain why our supplies have been cut off.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Darn it! What on earth happened up there...

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Hmph... Let's leave this topic for another day. War is war — there are no eternal allies nor perpetual enemies. That's the reality that we, the Fatui, live in.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: But I — at least for now — care about nothing but Kolya.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: When we retreated, he was separated from the squad... I came back for him later and got lost myself, too. *sigh* What a shame...

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: As for where he was before he went missing, I can mark it out on the map for you.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: At the time, he tried to lure the enemies chasing us away from the rest of the team... He's an excellent soldier, and I know for sure that he wouldn't die there.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: I can only hope that he has left us some clues...

choices.text: You certainly won't let us interfere with the Fatui's plans.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! If any good we do disrupts your evil plan, don't you try to stop us!

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Why are you talking about "good" or "evil"... and why would I stop you?

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: *sigh* You're starting to get on my nerves. Would you just let me finish?

choices.text: No worries. We haven't yet said yes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, you're a Fatuus! We won't even lift a finger to help if you're up to something evil!

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Pfft... you do have a point.

talks.objective: Look for clues Nikolay left behind

dialogues.speaker: Shred of Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "... Oh no! Katya's balalaika is broken. I somehow damaged it during the fracas. Gotta get it repaired before she chews me out..."

dialogues.speaker: Shred of Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "...Did our ancestors fight the calamity like this five hundred years ago? The Kapitan-Poruchik once said we knew not a hundredth of the grueling battles that our ancestors went through..."

dialogues.speaker: Shred of Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: (Many pages in the middle are tainted by some black substance. When you clean it off, the writing in ink is also rendered entirely illegible.)

dialogues.speaker: Shred of Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "...I can't stay here any longer. They could easily track me down through the black mud..."

dialogues.speaker: Shred of Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "...Next, I'm gonna go the opposite direction and lure them further away from the rest of the squad..."

dialogues.speaker: Shred of Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "...There's a hole near the ruined bastion on the southeast side. Maybe I can take that route..."

dialogues.speaker: Shred of Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "...Wish me luck. If not us, then who?"

talks.objective: Find the place mentioned in Nikolay's diary

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: You're back. I have some Fire-Water to spare.

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm not inviting you to drink. It can also be used to clean your wounds if you're injured.

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: How is it? Did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We found this.

talks.objective: Look for the place the diary mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: You're back. Did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: It's alright if you found nothing. Go get some rest.

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: Don't you worry about me... I'm not anxious. After all, I kinda wanna stay here for my retirement. Maybe I'll ask you to deal with my pension application!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you sure are getting some good rest!

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: Hmph, if you keep coming back here without bringing me any news... Who knows, you might just find me resting till I rest in peace.

talks.objective: Read the information Nikolay left behind

dialogues.speaker: Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "...I made it into this secret chamber. The mechanical monster is still lurking outside like a ferocious predator, just waiting for me to go out..."

dialogues.speaker: Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "...My left leg is badly wounded and it hurts like hell. I bandaged it up haphazardly, but it's swollen — could be a sign of infection..."

dialogues.speaker: Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "...The grotto has another exit, but I don't know where it leads. The structure of the exit looks tenuous. Without something to support it, it might collapse if exposed to violent force..."

dialogues.speaker: Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "...I've been spotted! Someone's coming. It's a... swordsman... clad in black?"

dialogues.speaker: Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "...He, no, it... Seems as though even metal bars are no obstacle for it. And just from looking upon it, I know this in my heart..."

dialogues.speaker: Kapral Nikolay's Diary
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry, Katya."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh... Is this the insignia left behind by the Fatui guy?

talks.objective: Tell Katarina about the clues you found

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: These are... insignias, action logs, and... note?

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: Please tell me where Kolya is. Is he still alive?

choices.text: We didn't find him, but he's probably still alive.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Kolya would never desert and abandon me. I'm sure of it, I just know it. He wouldn't run away in the face of a battle.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Where did you find these?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A cave in the southeast. Let me mark it out for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a creepy place with many monsters inside it.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Th—Thank you... I'm sorry...

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: I... I hope Kolya sold his life dearly. I'd rather that's what happened.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Kolya, please don't bring shame to the Tsaritsa. Don't bring shame on me.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Ahem, I—I'm fine... Just got a bit sentimental there. It just occurred to me that I haven't properly thanked you two!

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Oh right, here's some Fire-Water... *sigh* But you don't drink, do you?

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: I have some Mora...and some other materials that I collected. They are of no use to me now, so please take them.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: What's my plan next? Thank you for asking, but I don't need you to assist me in my "evil-doing" anymore.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Well, I'll go looking for Kolya, perhaps.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: He wrote me a letter before I was redeployed, which I have with me. For me, it's the only evidence left that proves his existence, and I'll carry it with me, forever.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: If he's still alive... As a Fatuus loyal to the Tsaritsa, I'll hunt this traitor down and kill him, wherever he goes or hides.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: If he is no longer in this world... As his older sister, I will embrace the inevitable fate of every Fatuus and will be proud of him.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: When we say "if not us, then who"... Well, this is what that means.

choices.text: What if you're up to something evil and I must stop you?

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: ...There's always a moment when you're left with no choice. And we all have things that we must do, right?

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: You're too serious. I mean, I get it. Kids who haven't grown old enough to hold their liquor tend to get drowned in all sorts of strange worries.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: I mean, we'll see, won't we? Let's see what I'll do when I need to face the final, inevitable choice.

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: But for now, what I need is to take a nap... Wanna rest too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's only a straw mat here. That doesn't make a comfy bed! You're just trying to get rid of us!

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Well, I don't see how that's my problem! Ah, I pity you...

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: But anyway, thank you for your help.

choices.text: Do you always have to do it the Fatui way?

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: Yes. Is that so strange?

response.speaker: Katarina
response.text: But anyway... Ideas, perspectives... What terribly boring avenues of inquiry! Pfft... Don't you go thinking that there are only ideas underneath my mask. I am certainly not bulletproof beneath it!

choices.text: He might've escaped through a secret tunnel.

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: I need to get some rest now. My old injuries still hurt. My apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Katarina
dialogues.text: Please come back another day if you have more questions. I'll also have a favor to ask.
